title: Care Academy Training Note — The Apparel Count Window for Deposit Pre-Order Replacements (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** For Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order replacements, the apparel reduction rests on the customer's apparel lines booked on Marlowe & Finch orders. The lines are counted over a window that depends on the membership:

- for a member enrolled 60 months or more: the lines of the last 24 months, divided by 2, a yearly average;
- for a member enrolled fewer than 12 months: the lines since the month of enrolment;
- for every other customer: the lines of the last 12 months.

Membership means the customer's active Marlowe Rewards membership. Its months run from the enrolment date to today. The lines are order lines of the apparel product class on the customer's Online Orders, each counted by its booking date.

**Questions and answers**

*A member enrolled 7 years ago has 11 apparel lines in the last 24 months. What is the count?*
11 divided by 2, which is 5.5.

*A member enrolled 4 months ago?*
The apparel lines booked since the month of enrolment.

*A member of 3 years?*
The apparel lines of the last 12 months.

| Months enrolled | 11 | 12 | 59 | 60 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Window | Since the month of enrolment | Last 12 months | Last 12 months | Last 24 months divided by 2 |
